[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-upstream-1082ff)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-repository-blue)](https://github.com/hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager)
[![CI](https://github.com/hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

## 0 Overview

DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later, prioritize, tag, and annotate. Batch operations.

Verified with the official DSH Desktop client; see [5 Compatibility](#5-compatibility) for the current verification scope. Both environments share the same plugin Host/client functionality; environment-specific installation notes are documented below.

## 1 Features

### 1.1 Session lifecycle management

- **Delete** is irreversible and always asks for confirmation. Subagent sessions and transient blank placeholders (no persisted artifact) cannot be deleted.
- **Archive / Unarchive** moves a session in and out of the active list without touching its disk content.
- **Move to workspace** keeps history, title, archive state and derived-session relationships intact, rewrites the session's `cwd` to the target workspace, synchronizes the runtime `workingDirectory` projection for active agents, and updates the live writer's header in place so any pending tool calls keep landing on the new path. When the session's `cwd` already equals the target workspace path but its membership was never recorded, only the missing membership is repaired: no `cwd` rewrite, no artifact rewrite or move, and no session restart.
- **Migrate Agent preset** rewrites the latest `agent-preset/selected` event (or the session header if no such event exists) so a session whose preset was renamed or removed can resume. Message history is never altered.

### 1.2 Session shortcuts

- **Favorites / Review-later** are manual flags that survive archive and session end; neither is cleared automatically.
- **Search** matches title, session ID, note and tags case-insensitively, trims whitespace, and never reads chat history.
- **Filters and sorting** combine a workspace selector (All / Ungrouped / specific) with an archive filter (All / Active / Archived), then layer favorites / review, tag and priority filters on top. Sort by recently updated (default), least recently updated, newest created, oldest created, name ascending (A-Z), name descending (Z-A), or **priority (1 → 5)**.
- **Priority** is a dropdown **1 Highest, 2 High, 3 Normal, 4 Low, 5 Lowest**, default **3 (Normal)**; legacy `null` priorities are normalized to 3.
- **Tags / Notes**: up to 20 tags per session (≤ 32 characters each) and a 2000-character note. Both English `,` and Chinese `，` are separators, whitespace is trimmed, duplicate tags are merged case-insensitively.
- **AI-assisted tagging** is manual and opt-in: **Copy Prompt** writes a structured prompt (Chinese or English, matched to the active UI) to the clipboard; **Import** parses the clipboard JSON (tolerating Markdown fences, conversational wrappers, smart quotes, stray backslashes and a leading BOM), validates it against the same limits, and populates the editor fields. Neither button calls a model automatically.
- Annotations live in plain text under the DSH home (`dsh-session-manager/annotations.v1.json`), keyed by session ID. Same-origin client instances stay in sync via `BroadcastChannel`. Saves are durable across crashes; revision conflicts surface a "load latest" prompt.

### 1.3 Bulk management

- **Batch process mode**: click the toggle in the panel header to reveal row checkboxes, a **Select all in filter / Clear selection** toolbar pair, and the bulk action bar. Exiting batch process clears the current selection.
- **Action bar** lists every batch action:
  - **Annotation toggles**: **Archive / Unarchive / Favorite / Unfavorite / Mark for review / Clear review flag**.
  - **Mutating actions**: **Add tags / Clear tags / Set priority / Move to workspace / Migrate preset / Delete session**.
- **Confirmation flow**:
  - Non-destructive actions (archive / unarchive / favorite / unfavorite / review / unreview / add-tags / clear-tags / set-priority / move / preset-migrate) fire immediately and report per-session results in a **result dialog** with **Success / Failed / Skipped** groups and a one-click **Retry failed** that re-arms the failed IDs into the selection.
  - Destructive actions (**delete session**) first open a **preview dialog** listing the targeted sessions, then show a progress bar, then a per-id result dialog.

### 1.4 Plugin updates and settings

- **Self-update check**: An **npm icon button** (Check for updates) in the session manager panel header checks for updates and displays a notification dot when a new version is available. Click to open the update dialog with current and latest versions, and one-click update via the DSH Plugin Manager with support for both HMR and non-HMR environments, persistent status tracking, automatic rollback on failure, and restart/refresh prompts.
- **Settings Card**: Registered under DSH Settings (`settings.plugin.item`). Displays current version, latest version, inline check/update buttons, an auto-check toggle, and GitHub repository link.
- **Install Source (Registry)**: Select between **npm official registry** (`registry.npmjs.org`, default) and **China mainland mirror** (`registry.npmmirror.com`) in the Settings Card. Check for updates and download packages directly from the selected registry.
- **Dialog opacity**: A 50%–100% slider (5% steps, default 100%) with a "Reset to default" button in the Settings Card's preferences section. Adjusts the background fill opacity of plugin dialogs in real time while keeping text, buttons, inputs, tags, and borders fully opaque.
- **Theme**: Automatically follows the active DSH theme (including third-party theme plugins). Dialogs, settings cards, title-bar buttons, menus, inputs, and all other UI elements seamlessly adapt to light and dark themes.
- **Unified dropdown styling**: All select dropdowns (sort, filter, priority) use unified shadow-free rounded custom floating menus matching active themes, strictly aligned with trigger widths, eliminating Chromium duplicate native popups.

### 1.5 Workspace Archiving and Management

- **Two-page tab switching**: Seamlessly switch between "Session Management" and "Workspace Management" in the dialog header, preserving each page's distinct search, filter, and sort states.
- **Workspace list**: Displays all registered workspaces with title/name, physical path, session count, latest activity timestamp computed from member sessions, and right-side toggle switch.
- **Search, filter, and sort**: Case-insensitive search across name and path; filter by All / Active / Archived; sort by Recently Updated, Earliest Updated, Name A-Z, or Name Z-A; counter display and adaptive toolbar wrapping.
- **Toggle switch and archiving**:
  - **Turn OFF (Archive)**: Pre-checks session activity (rejects safely if any session is running), cascades archiving to all unarchived member sessions, hides workspace from DSH native sidebar, and automatically rolls back if partial failure occurs.
  - **Turn ON (Restore)**: Removes archive mark, restores workspace in native sidebar, unarchives member sessions previously archived by the workspace operation while keeping individually archived sessions intact. Creating an identical-path workspace restores visibility automatically.
- **Native sidebar hiding without ungrouped spill**: Employs derived snapshot interception with session ID unioning into `archivedSessionIds` so hidden workspace sessions never spill into "Ungrouped", supporting dark/light themes and persistent recovery across DSH restarts.

## 2 UI entry points

### 2.1 Title bar

The right side of the title area exposes actions for the **current session**: **Archive / Unarchive**, **Favorites**, **Review-later**, **Tags / Notes**, **Move to workspace**, **Delete session**, and **More actions** (`⋯`), matching native DSH title-bar button sizing (28px height, transparent ghost style) and vector SVG icon design.

### 2.2 Sessions and workspaces management entry and interface

Open **Sessions & Workspaces** from the bottom of DSH's sidebar to browse all sessions and workspaces: the session management tab supports switching workspaces, searching by title / ID / notes / tags, applying filters and sorting, and running **Open / Archive / Unarchive / Tags / Notes / Move / Migrate preset / Delete** on any session row; the workspace management tab supports searching, sorting, bulk actions, and visibility toggling.

### 2.3 Bulk management

The **Batch process** button in the session manager panel header is the entry point: click it once to enter batch process (row checkboxes appear, the **Select all in filter / Clear selection** pair and the bulk action bar show up); click it again to exit batch process.

### 2.4 Settings Card

Navigate to DSH Settings -> Plugins -> Session Manager to inspect versions, switch between npm official and China mainland mirror registries, toggle auto-update checks, or trigger updates.

## 3 Installation

### 3.1 Install from Plugins

In DSH, open **Plugins**, add a plugin, search for `dsh-session-manager`, and install it. This method is supported by both the official Web UI and Desktop app.

### 3.2 Install from Third-Party Plugin Markets

This plugin is listed in [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) and [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin).

### 3.3 Install to the Web profile via CLI

Install from npm:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add npm:dsh-session-manager
```

Install from GitHub:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager
```

Restart DSH Web after installation. If the browser still loads an older client bundle, use `Ctrl+Shift+R` to force-refresh the page.

> The `desktop` profile is managed by the official Desktop app and is not intended to be modified with the regular `dsh` CLI. Desktop users should install the plugin through **Plugins** in the app.

### 3.4 Local Development / Testing

#### Web profile

Install the local repository via CLI:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-repository>
```

The local repository is linked to the current profile as a plugin checkout, making it suitable for modifying the source code directly and testing changes.

#### Desktop app

Open **Plugins** in the official Desktop app and use the absolute path to the local repository as the installation source.

For client-side code, changes can be reloaded automatically after saving when HMR is working normally. If a change does not take effect immediately, reload the current interface or restart the corresponding DSH Web / Desktop client.

After changing plugin dependencies, `package.json`, bundle configuration, or other installation- or loading-related settings, reinstalling the plugin or restarting the corresponding client is recommended.

## 4 Safety and behavior

- **Deletion is permanent**, so the UI always asks for confirmation. The API checks the session ID, directory boundary and artifact header before deletion; traversal, symlinks and junctions are refused.
- Move and preset migration keep the live session / agent alive; only deletion cancels and disposes the session. Move updates the stored `cwd` and the existing live writer's header.
- The management list hides subagent sessions and the move API rejects them. Blank sessions without a persisted artifact cannot be moved.
- Cold rewrites preserve the artifact's stored format (V1 / V2 / V3 / V4 are all readable; the plugin never forces an upgrade). Moves and rewrites refuse corrupt / truncated Zstd logs or JSONL logs with incomplete final lines instead of publishing partial history.
- Preset migration separates backup, publication and rollback. If rollback fails, recovery files are retained and their paths are included in the error; do not remove them.
- **Workspace archiving rollback protection**: archiving is refused if active sessions are present, and batch session archiving automatically rolls back on partial failures to preserve state consistency.
- On startup, sessions whose `cwd` names a registered workspace but whose membership record is missing are re-registered through the official DSH API (idempotent). Incomplete scans skip pruning only: existing membership is never dropped, and live sessions or memberships added during the scan are always preserved.
- Plugin mutations are serialized per session and request bodies are limited to 64 KiB. This queue supplements, rather than replaces, DSH's own persistence coordination.
- **Centralized API authentication**: All `/session-manager/api/*` routes are protected by DSH official `connection.admit()` and `requestRejection()` gates, strictly enforcing Owner-only privileges (`peer.principal.kind === "owner"`) and failing closed (HTTP 503) if connection services are absent, ensuring that exposed network tunnels or local proxies cannot bypass access control.

- Before submitting changes, run:

```powershell
npm run check
npm test
npm run check:package
git diff --check
```

Tests use isolated temporary directories and the real plugin entry point, never real sessions. CI runs these checks on Windows / Linux with Node 22.15.0 / 24.

Optional integration check: run `node scripts/smoke-test.mjs` against a running DSH Web-profile test instance. It contacts a real service and is not part of the default unit test suite.

/**
 * Retarget the existing live JSONL writer after its artifact is relocated.
 * The agent loop retains the original SessionHandle until the agent is
 * disposed; replacing the tracker entry with a newly opened handle leaves
 * that retained handle stale and can make later teardown delete the new
 * tracker entry. The compiled DSH handle exposes a writable runtime
 * header property even though the TypeScript declaration is readonly.
 * Mutating that property keeps the same handle, queue, cursor, and lease.
 */
function rebindLiveWriter(persistence, sessionId, newHeader) {
  const writer = liveWriterOf(persistence, sessionId);
  if (writer === undefined || writer === null) {
    throw new Error("当前 DSH 运行时未暴露可重绑定的 live persistence writer，无法安全迁移运行中的会话；请先关闭会话后重试");
  }

    throw new Error("当前持久化后端的 live writer 不支持安全重绑定；请先关闭会话后重试");
  }
  const reboundHeader = Object.freeze({ ...newHeader });

}


/** List every persisted session header visible to the configured persistence
 * backend, supplemented by raw-id sessions written by older DSH builds.
 *
 * Performance (issue #6): the disk loop previously opened and zstd-decoded
 * every candidate file in <dshHome>/sessions/<proj>/<dir>/ even when the
 * persistence layer had already returned those ids. On a healthy index
 * that wasted O(N * file_size) read+inflate per call -- the reporter
 * measured +17s CPU / +254 MB read per DSH startup on an 80-session /
 * 249 MB library. We now pre-build a `knownDirs` set from the persisted
 * ids (both `[id]` and `[encodeSessionSegment(id)]`) and skip matching
 * directories before any fopen. Orphan raw-id directories that the
 * index does not know about still fall through to the file read so the
 * disk fallback semantics are preserved -- the orphan is the whole
 * reason this loop exists.
 *
 * The result carries two completeness flags: "persisted" reports whether the
 * persistence index itself listed successfully (its rows are authoritative),
 * while "complete" additionally requires the disk sweep to finish without
 * errors. Callers that only add validated memberships may run on "persisted";
 * callers that remove records must wait for "complete".
 *
 * @param {object|undefined} persistence  DSH's sessionPersistence service
 * @param {((segment: string) => string)|undefined} dshHome  Resolver for
 *   DSH home sub-paths; only "sessions" is read.
 */
const scanSessionHeaders = async (persistence, dshHome) => {
  const seen = new Set();
  const headers = [];
  const errors = [];
  let listed = false;
  let persisted = false;
  if (typeof persistence?.list === "function") {
    try {
      const rows = await persistence.list();
      if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new Error("会话列表返回了无效数据");
      for (const row of rows) {
        const header = normalizeSessionHeader(row);
        if (!header) { errors.push(new Error("会话列表包含无效 header")); continue; }
        try { assertSessionId(header.id); }
        catch (error) { errors.push(error); continue; }
        if (!seen.has(header.id)) { seen.add(header.id); headers.push(header); }
      }
      listed = true;
      persisted = true;
    } catch (error) { errors.push(error); }
  }
  const result = () => ({ headers, persisted, complete: listed && errors.length === 0, errors });
  // Skip known files before fopen; retain the orphan/raw-id compatibility path.
  // Only add canonical session directories that do not start and end with "--"
  // to avoid colliding with legacy projectKey candidates (e.g. "--s1--").
  const knownDirs = new Set();
  for (const id of seen) {
    try {
      const canonical = encodeFsSessionSegment(id);
      if (!canonical.startsWith("--") || !canonical.endsWith("--")) {
        knownDirs.add(canonical);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  if (typeof dshHome !== "function") return result();
  const root = dshHome("sessions");
  let projects;
  try { projects = await readdir(root, { withFileTypes: true }); }
  catch (error) { errors.push(error); return result(); }
  listed = true;
  for (const proj of projects) {
    if (proj.isSymbolicLink()) { errors.push(new Error("跳过符号链接项目目录")); continue; }
    if (!proj.isDirectory()) continue;
    let dirs;
    try { dirs = await readdir(join(root, proj.name), { withFileTypes: true }); }
    catch (error) { errors.push(error); continue; }
    for (const entry of dirs) {
      if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) { errors.push(new Error("跳过符号链接会话目录")); continue; }
      if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue;
      if (knownDirs.has(entry.name)) continue;
      let found = false;
      for (const filename of ARTIFACT_NAMES) {
        try {
          const header = await readSessionHeader(join(root, proj.name, entry.name, filename));
          if (!candidateSessionDirs(header.id).includes(entry.name)) {
            throw new Error("会话目录与 header id 不一致");
          }
          if (!seen.has(header.id)) { seen.add(header.id); headers.push(header); }
          found = true;
          break;
        } catch (error) {
          if (error.code !== "ENOENT") { errors.push(error); break; }
        }
      }
      if (!found) errors.push(new Error("无法完整读取会话目录: " + join(root, proj.name, entry.name)));
    }
  }
  return result();
};

const listSessionHeaders = async (persistence, dshHome) => (await scanSessionHeaders(persistence, dshHome)).headers;

/** Canonicalize a directory path the way DSH's workspace registry does
 * (fs.realpath on a fully qualified path). Returns undefined when the path

const canonicalizeDirectory = async (path) => {
  if (typeof path !== "string" || path === "") return undefined;
  try { return await realpath(path); } catch { return undefined; }

function normalizeRegistryUrl(url) {
  if (!url || typeof url !== "string") return "";
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return "";
  return trimmed.endsWith("/") ? trimmed.slice(0, -1) : trimmed;
}

function resolveTrustedRegistry(requested, envRegistry) {
  const normEnv = normalizeRegistryUrl(envRegistry);
  const normReq = normalizeRegistryUrl(requested);

  if (normReq) {
    if (TRUSTED_REGISTRIES.has(normReq) || (normEnv && normReq === normEnv)) {
      return normReq;
    }
    return null;
  }

  if (normEnv && (TRUSTED_REGISTRIES.has(normEnv) || normEnv.length > 0)) {
    return normEnv;
  }

  return "https://registry.npmjs.org";
}

const ACTIVE_UPDATE_TASK_KEY = Symbol.for("dsh-session-manager.activeUpdateTask");

function getActiveTask() {
  return globalThis[ACTIVE_UPDATE_TASK_KEY] || null;
}

function setActiveTask(task) {
  if (task) {
    globalThis[ACTIVE_UPDATE_TASK_KEY] = task;
  } else {
    delete globalThis[ACTIVE_UPDATE_TASK_KEY];
  }
}

function releaseActiveTask(taskId) {
  const cur = getActiveTask();
  if (cur && (!taskId || cur.taskId === taskId)) {
    setActiveTask(null);
  }
}

function isPidAlive(pid) {
  if (typeof pid !== "number" || pid <= 0) return false;
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    return err.code === "EPERM";
  }
}

function getUpdateStatusFilePath(profileDir) {
  return profileDir ? join(profileDir, UPDATE_STATUS_FILE) : null;
}

function writeUpdateStatus(profileDir, statusObj) {
  const filePath = getUpdateStatusFilePath(profileDir);
  if (!filePath || !statusObj || typeof statusObj !== "object") return;
  statusObj.updatedAt = Date.now();
  try {
    if (existsSync(filePath)) {
      const existing = JSON.parse(readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));
      if (existing && existing.taskId && statusObj.taskId && existing.taskId !== statusObj.taskId) {
        if (isDiskTaskActive(existing) && (existing.startedAt || 0) > (statusObj.startedAt || 0)) {
          return;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  const tmpPath = filePath + ".tmp." + Date.now();
  try {
    writeFileSync(tmpPath, JSON.stringify(statusObj, null, 2), "utf8");
    try {
      renameSync(tmpPath, filePath);
    } catch {
      try { rmSync(filePath, { force: true }); } catch (_) {}
      renameSync(tmpPath, filePath);
    }
  } catch (_) {
    try { if (existsSync(tmpPath)) rmSync(tmpPath, { force: true }); } catch (_) {}
  }
}

function readUpdateStatus(profileDir) {
  const filePath = getUpdateStatusFilePath(profileDir);
  if (!filePath) return null;
  try {
    if (existsSync(filePath)) {
      return JSON.parse(readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));
    }
  } catch (_) { /* best-effort */ }
  return null;
}

const ACTIVE_TASK_STATUSES = new Set([
  "preparing",
  "removing",
  "removed",
  "installing",
  "verifying",
  "rolling-back"
]);

function isDiskTaskActive(statusObj) {
  if (!statusObj || typeof statusObj !== "object") return false;
  if (!ACTIVE_TASK_STATUSES.has(statusObj.status)) return false;

  // If status was recorded by the current process, consult in-memory task
  if (statusObj.pid === process.pid) {
    const inMem = getActiveTask();
    if (!inMem || inMem.taskId !== statusObj.taskId) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // If status was recorded by another process, check if PID is alive
  if (typeof statusObj.pid === "number") {
    if (!isPidAlive(statusObj.pid)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  const lastActive = typeof statusObj.updatedAt === "number"
    ? statusObj.updatedAt
    : (typeof statusObj.startedAt === "number" ? statusObj.startedAt : 0);
  if (Date.now() - lastActive > HEARTBEAT_STALE_TIMEOUT_MS) return false;
  return true;
}

function isTaskActive(statusObj) {
  return isDiskTaskActive(statusObj);
}

export function apply(ctx) {
  try {
    const buildId = "dsh-session-manager v0.7.5 (workspace-archive)";
    if (typeof ctx?.logger?.info === "function") ctx.logger.info(buildId);
    else if (typeof console !== "undefined" && console?.info) console.info(buildId);
  } catch (_) { /* ignore logging failures */ }
  const adapter = createDshAdapter(ctx);
  let annotationStore;
  const annotations = () => {
    if (!annotationStore) {
      const home = adapter.homePath;
      if (typeof home !== "function") throw Object.assign(new Error("会话标记存储不可用"), { code: "annotations-unavailable" });
      annotationStore = createAnnotationStore(home("dsh-session-manager"));
    }
    return annotationStore;
  };
  let workspaceArchiveStore;
  const workspaceArchives = () => {
    if (!workspaceArchiveStore) {
      const home = adapter.homePath;
      if (typeof home === "function") {
        try {
          workspaceArchiveStore = createWorkspaceArchiveStore(home("dsh-session-manager"));
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      if (!workspaceArchiveStore) {
        workspaceArchiveStore = createWorkspaceArchiveStore(null, { memory: true });
      }
    }
    return workspaceArchiveStore;
  };
  const safeGetAgent = (sessionId) => {
    try { return ctx.agents?.get?.(sessionId); } catch { return undefined; }
  };
  /** Durable workspace membership for one entity. The record account is the
   * authoritative persisted list on DSH 0.2.x (registry entities expose it as
   * the private `record` field); the runtime `sessionIds` getter is filtered
   * by the canonical-cwd index and may hide members whose index entry is
   * stale, so it is only a fallback for hosts without a readable record. */
  const workspaceMemberIds = (entity) => {
    if (entity === null || entity === undefined) return [];
    const record = entity.record;
    if (record !== null && record !== undefined && Array.isArray(record.sessionIds)) return record.sessionIds;
    const ids = entity.sessionIds;
    if (Array.isArray(ids)) return ids;
    if (typeof ids === "function") {
      try { const value = ids(); if (Array.isArray(value)) return value; } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    return [];
  };
  const assertAnnotatable = id => {
    const registry = adapter.workspaceRegistry;
    if (adapter.getSession(id) !== undefined || registry?.headers?.has?.(id)
      || adapter.workspaceList().some(ws => workspaceMemberIds(ws).includes(id))) return;
    throw Object.assign(new Error("会话不存在或尚未加载，请先打开该会话后重试"), { code: "session-not-found" });
  };
  const operations = new Map();
  const mutate = (id, operation) => {
    const pending = (operations.get(id) ?? Promise.resolve()).then(operation);
    const settled = pending.catch(() => {}).finally(() => {
      if (operations.get(id) === settled) operations.delete(id);
    });
    operations.set(id, settled);
    return pending;
  };
  const readBody = async (req) => {
    const chunks = [];
    let size = 0;
    for await (const chunk of req) {
      const bytes = Buffer.from(chunk);
      size += bytes.length;
      if (size > 64 * 1024) throw Object.assign(new Error("请求体超过 64 KiB"), { code: "body-too-large" });
      chunks.push(bytes);
    }
    return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
  };

  const send = (res, code, obj) => {
    res.writeHead(code, { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(obj));
  };

  /** Remove one id from the registry-global archive set (durable, serialized). */
  const unarchiveSession = async (sessionId) => {
    const ui = adapter.uiWorkspace;
    if (ui && typeof ui.unarchiveSession === "function") {
      await ui.unarchiveSession(sessionId);
      return;
    }
    const registry = ctx.get("workspaceRegistry") ?? ctx.workspaceRegistry ?? adapter.workspaceRegistry;
    if (registry && typeof registry.unarchiveSession === "function") {
      await registry.unarchiveSession(sessionId);
      return;
    }
    if (!registry || typeof registry.enqueueOperation !== "function" || typeof registry.requireState !== "function" || typeof registry.setState !== "function") {
      const error = new Error(`cannot unarchive session '${sessionId}': workspaceRegistry service is unavailable`);
      error.code = "workspace-registry-unavailable";
      throw error;
    }
    await registry.enqueueOperation(async () => {
      const state = registry.requireState();
      if (!state.archivedSessionIds.includes(sessionId)) return;
      await registry.setState({
        ...state,
        archivedSessionIds: state.archivedSessionIds.filter((id) => id !== sessionId)
      });
    });
  };

  /** Add one id to the registry-global archive set (durable, serialized).
   *  Prefers official uiWorkspace or workspaceRegistry services without bypassing rejections.
   *  Default preserves running agents (stopActivity: false). When active, archive fails unless explicitly told to stop.
   *  Direct write fallback mirrors official DSH semantics: checks activity when stopActivity !== true,
   *  updates archived/pinned state, and stops activity after writing when requested.
   *  If equivalent semantics cannot be guaranteed (e.g. stop requested but no stop interface available),
   *  safely rejects without modifying registry state. */
  const archiveSession = async (sessionId, options = {}) => {
    const stopActivity = options.stopActivity === true;
    const ui = adapter.uiWorkspace;
    if (ui && typeof ui.archiveSession === "function") {
      await ui.archiveSession(sessionId, { stopActivity });
      return;
    }
    const registry = ctx.get("workspaceRegistry") ?? ctx.workspaceRegistry ?? adapter.workspaceRegistry;
    if (registry && typeof registry.archiveSession === "function") {
      await registry.archiveSession(sessionId, { stopActivity });
      return;
    }
    if (!registry || typeof registry.enqueueOperation !== "function" || typeof registry.requireState !== "function" || typeof registry.setState !== "function") {
      const error = new Error(`cannot archive session '${sessionId}': workspaceRegistry service is unavailable`);
      error.code = "workspace-registry-unavailable";
      throw error;
    }

    if (stopActivity) {
      const hasStopFn = typeof registry.stopSessionActivity === "function" || typeof ctx.parallel === "function";
      if (!hasStopFn) {
        const error = new Error(`cannot archive session '${sessionId}': no valid stop activity interface available`);
        error.code = "stop-activity-unavailable";
        throw error;
      }
    }

    await registry.enqueueOperation(async () => {
      const state = registry.requireState();
      if (state.archivedSessionIds.includes(sessionId)) return;

      if (typeof registry.sessionKnown === "function") {
        const known = await registry.sessionKnown(sessionId);
        if (!known) {
          const error = new Error(`cannot archive session '${sessionId}': session not found`);
          error.code = "workspace/unknown-session";
          throw error;
        }
      }

      if (!stopActivity) {
        const liveSession = ctx.sessions?.get?.(sessionId);
        const liveAgent = safeGetAgent(sessionId);
        const activeTurn = liveSession?.activeTurn;
        const agentRunning = liveAgent?.status === "running" || liveAgent?.busy === true;
        if (activeTurn !== undefined || agentRunning) {
          const kinds = [
            ...(activeTurn !== undefined ? ["active turn"] : []),
            ...(agentRunning ? ["agent running"] : [])
          ].join(", ");
          const error = new Error(`cannot archive session '${sessionId}': the session is active (${kinds})`);
          error.code = "workspace/session-active";
          throw error;
        }

      if (added || removed) {
        ctx.logger.info('session-manager: post-boot workspace reconcile attached ' + added + ' unaccounted sessions, removed ' + removed + ' orphans');
      }
      if (!scan.persisted) {
        ctx.logger.warn("session-manager: incomplete session scan; workspace reconciliation skipped: " + scan.errors.map(safeErrorMessage).join("; "));
        return;
      }
      if (!scan.complete) {
        ctx.logger.warn("session-manager: incomplete disk sweep; workspace membership pruning skipped: " + scan.errors.map(safeErrorMessage).join("; "));
        return;
      }

      // Step 2: Budgeted Background Projection Cache Rebuild
      if (typeof cache?.coldSnapshot !== "function") return;
      const isThreeArgCache = typeof cache.cachedSnapshot === "function" || cache.coldSnapshot.length >= 3;

      const assignedIds = new Set(registry.list().flatMap(ws => ws.record?.sessionIds ?? []));
      const candidates = headers.filter(header => assignedIds.has(header.id) || headers.length <= MAX_BOOT_REFOLD_COUNT);

      const startTime = Date.now();
      let attemptedCount = 0;
      let refoldCount = 0;

      for (const header of candidates) {
        if (attemptedCount >= MAX_BOOT_REFOLD_COUNT || Date.now() - startTime > MAX_BOOT_REFOLD_MS) {
          ctx.logger.info(`session-manager: boot projection cache refold budget reached (${attemptedCount} attempted, ${refoldCount} refolded, ${candidates.length - attemptedCount} remaining deferred)`);
          break;
        }

        try {
          if (typeof cache.cachedSnapshot === "function" && cache.cachedSnapshot(header) !== undefined) {
            continue;
          }

          attemptedCount++;

          // Check file size budget before any I/O
          const size = await getSessionSizeBytes(header.id);
          if (typeof size === "number" && size > MAX_SINGLE_ARTIFACT_BYTES) {
            ctx.logger.info(`session-manager: skipping boot cache refold for large artifact "${header.id}" (${size} bytes)`);
            continue;
          }

          // Yield to event loop between sessions so other tasks/HTTP requests stay responsive
          await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve));

          if (!isThreeArgCache) {
            try {
              await cache.coldSnapshot(header.id);
              refoldCount++;
            } catch (error) {
              if (String(error).includes("SessionLogOffset")) break;
              ctx.logger.warn('session-manager: post-boot cache refold failed: ' + safeErrorMessage(error));
            }
            continue;
          }

          const ok = await refoldSessionProjection({
            sessionId: header.id,
            header,
            isThreeArgCache,
            cache
          });
          if (ok) refoldCount++;
        } catch (error) {
          ctx.logger.warn('session-manager: post-boot cache refold failed for "' + header.id + '": ' + safeErrorMessage(error));
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      ctx.logger.warn("session-manager: post-boot reconcile failed: " + safeErrorMessage(error));
    }
  }, "session-manager: post-boot re-fold stale projection cache rows");

  /**
   * Runtime membership repair (issue #41): DSH's own create/fork flow attaches
   * a session to its workspace, but a session created outside that flow -- or
   * one whose host-side attach failed -- stays unaccounted even though its
   * cwd names a registered workspace, and would otherwise only be repaired on
   * the next DSH restart. Repair it as soon as the session is announced.
   *
   * The listener must never throw synchronously: a throwing session/created
   * listener rolls back session creation in DSH. Everything is contained and
   * fire-and-forget; failures are logged only.
   */
  if (typeof ctx.on === "function") ctx.on("session/created", (session) => {
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const header = session?.header ?? session;
        if (header === void 0 || typeof header.id !== "string") return;
        const attached = await attachSessionToOwningWorkspace(header);
        if (attached) {
          ctx.logger.info("session-manager: attached new session '" + header.id + "' to its cwd workspace");
        }
      } catch (error) {
        ctx.logger.warn("session-manager: session/created membership repair failed: " + safeErrorMessage(error));
      }
    })();
  });

  /** Build a normalized annotation patch from one bulk action + payload.
   * Returns null when the payload is missing or malformed so the caller can
   * surface a 400 instead of letting the store throw on a bad value.
   */
  const annotationPatchFromBatchAction = (action, payload) => {
    if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object") return null;
    if (action === "favorite" || action === "unfavorite") return { favorite: action === "favorite" };
    if (action === "review" || action === "unreview") return { reviewLater: action === "review" };
    if (action === "set-priority") {
      const p = Number(payload.priority);
      if (!Number.isInteger(p) || p < 1 || p > 5) return null;
      return { priority: p };
    }
    if (action === "add-tags" || action === "remove-tags") {
      if (!Array.isArray(payload.tags)) return null;
      return action === "add-tags" ? { tags: payload.tags } : { tags: [] };
    }
    return null;
  };

  /** Run one batch action against a single session id. Annotation-affecting
   *  actions resolve the annotation accessor from the surrounding closure
   *  so it can never be silently undefined. Session-management actions reuse
   *  the existing helpers verbatim so move/preset-migrate validation and
   *  live-session handling stay identical to the per-row buttons.
   */
  const runBatchAction = async ({ action, sessionId, payload, mutate, deleteSession, unarchiveSession, moveSession, migratePreset, adapter }) => {
    const annotationsAccessor = annotations;
    if (action === "favorite" || action === "unfavorite" || action === "review" || action === "unreview" || action === "set-priority" || action === "add-tags" || action === "remove-tags") {
      const patch = annotationPatchFromBatchAction(action, payload);
      if (patch === null) {
        const e = new Error("invalid batch payload for " + action); e.code = "bad-request"; throw e;
      }
      try {
        await annotationsAccessor().batchUpdate([sessionId], patch);
      } catch (error) {
        throw error;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (action === "archive") { await mutate(sessionId, () => archiveSession(sessionId, { stopActivity: payload?.stopActivity === true })); return; }
    if (action === "unarchive") { await mutate(sessionId, () => unarchiveSession(sessionId)); return; }
    if (action === "delete") { await mutate(sessionId, () => deleteSession(sessionId)); return; }
    if (action === "move") {
      const targetWorkspaceId = typeof payload?.targetWorkspaceId === "string" ? payload.targetWorkspaceId.trim() : "";
      if (!targetWorkspaceId) { const e = new Error("targetWorkspaceId required"); e.code = "bad-request"; throw e; }
      await mutate(sessionId, () => moveSession(sessionId, targetWorkspaceId));
      return;
    }
    if (action === "preset-migrate") {
      const toPreset = typeof payload?.toPreset === "string" ? payload.toPreset.trim() : "";
      if (!toPreset) { const e = new Error("toPreset required"); e.code = "bad-request"; throw e; }
      await mutate(sessionId, () => migratePreset({ sessionId, toPreset }));
      return;
    }
    const snapshot = adapter.workspaceRegistry?.headers?.get?.(sessionId)
      ?? adapter.sessions?.list?.()?.find(s => s?.id === sessionId)?.header
      ?? null;
    const isSubagent = snapshot?.origin === "subagent";
    const isBlank = snapshot?.blank === true;
    if (isSubagent) { const e = new Error("subagent"); e.code = "subagent-skip"; throw e; }
    if (isBlank) { const e = new Error("blank"); e.code = "blank-skip"; throw e; }
  };

  /**
   * Issue #43: Validate incoming request with DSH connection authentication.
   * Reuses DSH official Connection/Gateway authentication and authorization mechanisms.
   * Strict fail-closed: requires connection.admit() to succeed with a valid Owner peer.
   * Must execute before request body reading, JSON parsing, or business operations.
   */
  const authenticateApiRequest = (req) => {
    const connection = getService(ctx, "connection");
    if (!connection || typeof connection.admit !== "function") {
      return {
        ok: false,
        status: 503,
        code: "auth-unavailable",
        error: "DSH 认证服务未就绪或不可用，为保护数据安全已拒绝请求"
      };
    }
    try {
      const admission = connection.admit(req);
      if (!admission || typeof admission !== "object") {
        return {
          ok: false,
          status: 401,
          code: "unauthorized",
          error: "未授权：需要有效的 DSH 会话凭证"
        };
      }
      if ("rejection" in admission) {
        const status = typeof admission.rejection === "number" ? admission.rejection : 401;
        const error = status === 403
          ? "禁止访问：请求未通过 DSH 信任检查或跨站防护"
          : "未授权：需要有效的 DSH 会话凭证";
        return { ok: false, status, code: status === 403 ? "forbidden" : "unauthorized", error };
      }
      const peer = admission.peer;
      if (!peer || typeof peer !== "object") {
        return {
          ok: false,
          status: 401,
          code: "unauthorized",
          error: "未授权：缺少有效 Peer 凭证"
        };
      }
      const principalKind = peer.principal?.kind;
      if (principalKind !== "owner") {
        return {
          ok: false,
          status: 403,
          code: "forbidden",
          error: "禁止访问：会话管理属于特权操作，需要 owner 权限"
        };
      }
      return { ok: true, peer };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        status: 403,
        code: "auth-error",
        error: "认证检查失败: " + safeErrorMessage(err)
      };
    }
  };

  ctx.effect(() => ctx.webServer.register({
    kind: "prefix",
    path: API_PREFIX,
    handler: async (req, res) => {
      const auth = authenticateApiRequest(req);
      if (!auth.ok) {
        return send(res, auth.status, {
          ok: false,
          code: auth.code,
          error: auth.error
        });
      }
      try {
        const url = new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
        const path = url.pathname.startsWith(API_PREFIX) ? url.pathname.slice(API_PREFIX.length) || "/" : "/";
        let body = {};
        if (req.method === "POST") {
          const raw = await readBody(req);
          if (raw.trim() !== "") {
            try { body = JSON.parse(raw); }
            catch { return send(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "请求体不是合法 JSON" }); }
          }
        }
        if (body === null || typeof body !== "object" || Array.isArray(body)) {
          return send(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "请求体必须是 JSON 对象" });
        }
        const sessionId = typeof body.sessionId === "string" ? body.sessionId.trim() : "";
        if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/annotations") {
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result: { annotations: await annotations().list() } });
        }
        if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/annotations") {
          assertSessionId(sessionId);
          const annotation = await mutate(sessionId, async () => {
            assertAnnotatable(sessionId);
            return annotations().update(sessionId, body.patch, body.expectedRevision);
          });
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result: { sessionId, annotation } });
        }
        if (req.method === "POST" && ["/delete", "/unarchive", "/move", "/preset-migrate"].includes(path)) {
          assertSessionId(sessionId);
          let result;
          if (path === "/delete") {
            try {
              result = await mutate(sessionId, () => deleteSession(sessionId));
              try { await workspaceArchives().removeSession(sessionId); } catch (_) {}
            } catch (delErr) {
              const status = delErr?.code === "bad-request" ? 400 : 500;
              return send(res, status, {
                ok: false,
                error: safeErrorMessage(delErr),
                ...(typeof delErr?.code === "string" ? { code: delErr.code } : {}),
                deletedSubagents: Array.isArray(delErr?.deletedSubagentIds) ? delErr.deletedSubagentIds : [],
                remainingSessions: Array.isArray(delErr?.remainingSessionIds) ? delErr.remainingSessionIds : [sessionId],
                partialFailure: Boolean(delErr?.partialFailure)
              });
            }
          } else if (path === "/unarchive") {
            await mutate(sessionId, () => unarchiveSession(sessionId));
            result = { sessionId };
          } else if (path === "/move") {
            const targetWorkspaceId = typeof body.targetWorkspaceId === "string" ? body.targetWorkspaceId.trim() : "";
            if (!targetWorkspaceId) return send(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "targetWorkspaceId 必填" });
            result = await mutate(sessionId, () => moveSession(sessionId, targetWorkspaceId));
          } else {
            const toPreset = typeof body.toPreset === "string" ? body.toPreset.trim() : "";
            if (!toPreset) return send(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "toPreset 必填" });
            result = await mutate(sessionId, () => migratePreset({ sessionId, toPreset }));
          }
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result });
        }
        if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/workspace-archive") {
          const workspaceId = typeof body.workspaceId === "string" ? body.workspaceId.trim() : "";
          assertWorkspaceId(workspaceId);
          const sessionIds = Array.isArray(body.sessionIds) ? body.sessionIds : [];
          for (const id of sessionIds) assertSessionId(id);
          const pending = Array.isArray(body.pending) ? body.pending : [];
          for (const id of pending) assertSessionId(id);
          const record = await workspaceArchives().setArchive(workspaceId, {
            sessionIds,
            pending,
            archivedAt: typeof body.archivedAt === "number" ? body.archivedAt : Date.now()
          });
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result: { workspaceId, record } });
        }
        if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/workspace-unarchive") {
          const workspaceId = typeof body.workspaceId === "string" ? body.workspaceId.trim() : "";
          assertWorkspaceId(workspaceId);
          const pending = Array.isArray(body.pending) ? body.pending : [];
          for (const id of pending) assertSessionId(id);
          const retainSessionIds = body.retainSessionIds === true;
          const record = await workspaceArchives().setUnarchive(workspaceId, { pending, retainSessionIds });
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result: { workspaceId, record } });
        }
        if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/workspace-archives") {
          let archives = {};
          try {
            archives = await workspaceArchives().getAll();
          } catch (err) {
            return send(res, 500, { ok: false, error: safeErrorMessage(err) });
          }
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result: { archives } });
        }
        if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/batch") {
          // Per-action body shape (each action validates its own payload):
          //   archive       : no payload
          //   unarchive     : no payload
          //   delete        : no payload
          //   move          : { targetWorkspaceId }
          //   preset-migrate: { toPreset }
          //   favorite      : no payload (defaults to true)
          //   unfavorite    : no payload
          //   review        : no payload
          //   unreview      : no payload
          //   set-priority  : { priority: 1..5 }
          //   add-tags      : { tags: string[] }
          //   remove-tags   : { tags: string[] }
          const rawAction = typeof body.action === "string" ? body.action : "";
          const rawIds = Array.isArray(body.sessionIds) ? body.sessionIds : [];
          const ids = Array.from(new Set(rawIds.filter(id => typeof id === "string" && id.trim() !== "").map(id => id.trim())));
          for (const id of ids) assertSessionId(id);
          if (ids.length === 0) return send(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "sessionIds 必须是非空数组", code: "bad-request" });
          if (ids.length > 200) return send(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "单次批量最多 200 条，请缩小筛选范围后重试", code: "batch-too-large" });
          const payload = body.payload && typeof body.payload === "object" ? body.payload : {};
          const BATCH_ACTIONS = new Set(["archive", "unarchive", "delete", "move", "preset-migrate", "favorite", "unfavorite", "review", "unreview", "set-priority", "add-tags", "remove-tags"]);
          if (!BATCH_ACTIONS.has(rawAction)) return send(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "action 不支持: " + rawAction, code: "bad-request" });
          const items = [];
          let success = 0, failed = 0, skipped = 0;
          if (rawAction === "delete") {
            const deletedSet = new Set();
            for (const sessionId of ids) {
              if (deletedSet.has(sessionId)) {
                items.push({ sessionId, status: "success", cascaded: true, subagentCount: 0 });
                success++;
                continue;
              }
              try {
                const res = await mutate(sessionId, () => deleteSession(sessionId));
                deletedSet.add(sessionId);
                if (Array.isArray(res?.deletedSubagents)) {
                  for (const subId of res.deletedSubagents) {
                    deletedSet.add(subId);
                  }
                }
                items.push({
                  sessionId,
                  status: "success",
                  deletedSubagents: res?.deletedSubagents || [],
                  subagentCount: res?.subagentCount || 0,
                  warnings: res?.warnings || (res?.warning ? [res.warning] : [])
                });
                success++;
              } catch (error) {
                const code = error && typeof error.code === "string" ? error.code : undefined;
                if (Array.isArray(error?.deletedSubagentIds)) {
                  for (const subId of error.deletedSubagentIds) {
                    deletedSet.add(subId);
                  }
                }
                items.push({
                  sessionId,
                  status: "failed",
                  code,
                  error: safeErrorMessage(error),
                  deletedSubagents: error?.deletedSubagentIds || [],
                  remainingSessions: error?.remainingSessionIds || [sessionId],
                  partialFailure: Boolean(error?.partialFailure)
                });
                failed++;
              }
            }
          } else {
            for (const sessionId of ids) {
              try {
                await runBatchAction({ action: rawAction, sessionId, payload, mutate, deleteSession, unarchiveSession, moveSession, migratePreset, adapter });
                items.push({ sessionId, status: "success" });
                success++;
              } catch (error) {
                const code = error && typeof error.code === "string" ? error.code : undefined;
                if (code === "subagent-skip" || code === "blank-skip") {
                  items.push({ sessionId, status: "skipped", reason: code });
                  skipped++;
                } else {
                  items.push({ sessionId, status: "failed", code, error: safeErrorMessage(error) });
                  failed++;
                }
              }
            }
          }
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result: {
            summary: { total: ids.length, success, failed, skipped },
            items,
            aborted: false,
          } });
        }
        if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/delete-preview") {
          const rawId = url.searchParams.get("sessionId") || "";
          const sessionId = rawId.trim();
          if (sessionId) assertSessionId(sessionId);
          const rawIds = url.searchParams.get("sessionIds");
          let sessionIds = sessionId ? [sessionId] : [];
          if (rawIds) {
            const split = rawIds.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            for (const id of split) assertSessionId(id);
            sessionIds = Array.from(new Set([...sessionIds, ...split]));
          }
          if (sessionIds.length === 0) {
            return send(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "sessionId 或 sessionIds 必填" });
          }
          try {
            const descendants = await findDescendantSubagents(sessionIds);
            return send(res, 200, {
              ok: true,
              result: {
                subagentCount: descendants.length,
                subagents: descendants.map(d => ({ id: d.id, parentSession: d.parentSession }))
              }
            });
          } catch (err) {
            return send(res, 500, { ok: false, error: safeErrorMessage(err) });
          }
        }
        if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/workspaces") {
          const cachedHeaders = adapter.cachedSessionHeaders();
          const sessionCreatedAt = Object.fromEntries(cachedHeaders
            .filter(header => typeof header.createdAt === "number" || typeof header.createdAt === "string")
            .map(header => [header.id, header.createdAt]));
          const sessionUpdatedAt = Object.fromEntries(cachedHeaders
            .filter(header => header && (typeof header.updatedAt === "number" || typeof header.updatedAt === "string" || typeof header.lastModified === "number"))
            .map(header => [header.id, header.updatedAt ?? header.lastModified]));
          let workspaceArchivesMap = {};
          try {
            workspaceArchivesMap = await workspaceArchives().getAll();
          } catch (_) {}
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result: { workspaces: listWorkspaces(), sessionCreatedAt, sessionUpdatedAt, workspaceArchives: workspaceArchivesMap } });
        }
        if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/preset-scan") {
          const sessionId = url.searchParams.get("sessionId") || "";
          if (sessionId) assertSessionId(sessionId);
          const result = await scanPreset({ id: url.searchParams.get("workspaceId") || "", sessionId });
          return send(res, 200, { ok: true, result });
        }
        if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/update/check") {
          const currentVersion = adapter.pluginVersion() || "0.7.5";
          const runningVersion = currentVersion;
          let installedVersion = runningVersion;
          const profileDir = resolveProfileDir(adapter, ctx);
          if (profileDir) {
            const diskCheck = verifyInstalledPackage(profileDir);
            if (diskCheck.ok && diskCheck.version) {
              installedVersion = diskCheck.version;
            }
          }
          const pm = adapter.pluginManager;
          let bundles = [];
          if (typeof pm?.listBundles === "function") {
            try { bundles = await pm.listBundles(); } catch (_) {}
          }
          const source = detectPluginSource(adapter, ctx, bundles);
          if (source === "linked") {
            return send(res, 200, {
              ok: true,
              result: {
                runningVersion,
                currentVersion: runningVersion,
                installedVersion,
                latestVersion: runningVersion,
                hasUpdate: false,
                source: "linked",
                message: "开发模式（本地链接），请手动修改或拉取代码"
              }
            });
          }
          if (source === "github") {
            return send(res, 200, {
              ok: true,
              result: {
                runningVersion,
                currentVersion: runningVersion,
                installedVersion,
                latestVersion: runningVersion,
                hasUpdate: false,
                source: "github",
                message: "通过 Git/GitHub 安装，请通过 DSH 插件市场或 git 更新"
              }
            });
          }
          if (source === "installation") {
            return send(res, 200, {
              ok: true,
              result: {
                runningVersion,
                currentVersion: runningVersion,
                installedVersion,
                latestVersion: runningVersion,
                hasUpdate: false,
                source: "installation",
                message: "系统内置插件，无法独立更新"
              }
            });
          }
          if (source === "unknown") {
            return send(res, 200, {
              ok: true,
              result: {
                runningVersion,
                currentVersion: runningVersion,
                installedVersion,
                latestVersion: runningVersion,
                hasUpdate: false,
                source: "unknown",
                message: "无法确认插件安装来源，为保证安全已禁止自动更新"
              }
            });
          }
          let latestVersion = installedVersion;
          let hasUpdate = false;
          try {
            const envRegistry = process.env.NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY?.trim();
            const requestedRegistry = url.searchParams.get("registry")?.trim();
            const registry = resolveTrustedRegistry(requestedRegistry, envRegistry);
            if (!registry) {
              return send(res, 400, {
                ok: false,
                code: "untrusted-registry",
                error: "不受信任的 npm 安装源: " + requestedRegistry
              });
            }
            const base = registry.endsWith("/") ? registry : registry + "/";
            const pkgUrl = new URL("dsh-session-manager/latest", base).toString();
            const controller = new AbortController();
            const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 6000);
            try {
              const response = await fetch(pkgUrl, {
                signal: controller.signal,
                headers: { "accept": "application/json" }
              });
              if (response.ok) {
                const data = await response.json();
                if (data && typeof data.version === "string") {
                  latestVersion = data.version;
                }
              }
            } finally {
              clearTimeout(timer);
            }
            hasUpdate = compareSemver(latestVersion, installedVersion) > 0;
            const restartRequired = compareSemver(installedVersion, runningVersion) > 0;
            return send(res, 200, {
              ok: true,
              result: {
                runningVersion,
                currentVersion: runningVersion,
                installedVersion,
                latestVersion,
                hasUpdate,
                restartRequired,
                source: "npm"
              }
            });
          } catch (err) {
            return send(res, 200, {
              ok: false,
              code: "update-check-failed",
              error: "检查更新失败: " + safeErrorMessage(err),
              result: {
                runningVersion,
                currentVersion: runningVersion,
                installedVersion,
                latestVersion: installedVersion,
                hasUpdate: false,
                source: "npm"
              }
            });
          }
        }
        if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/update/install") {
          const rawVersion = typeof body?.version === "string" ? body.version.trim() : "";
          if (rawVersion && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$/.test(rawVersion)) {
            return send(res, 400, { ok: false, code: "bad-request", error: "Invalid version format" });
          }

          const pm = adapter.pluginManager;
          if (!pm || typeof pm.installBundle !== "function") {
            return send(res, 501, {
              ok: false,
              code: "plugin-manager-unavailable",
              error: "当前宿主环境未提供 PluginManager 安装服务，请通过 DSH 插件市场或命令行更新"
            });

  if (raw === "..") return "~002E~002E";

  if (typeof path !== "string") return "--root--";
  let readable = "";
  let separatorRun = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {

function parseHeader(content) {
  const newline = content.indexOf("\n");
  if (newline < 0) throw new Error("会话工件缺少完整头行");
  const header = JSON.parse(content.slice(0, newline));

}

async function assertRegularFile(path) {
  const info = await fs.lstat(path);

/** Header-only discovery: never inflate the history just to list an orphan. */
export async function readSessionHeader(path) {
  await assertRegularFile(path);
  const handle = await fs.open(path, "r");
  try {
    let buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
    while (buffer.length < MAX_HEADER_BYTES) {
      const chunk = Buffer.alloc(Math.min(64 * 1024, MAX_HEADER_BYTES - buffer.length));
      const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(chunk, 0, chunk.length, buffer.length);
      if (bytesRead === 0) break;
      buffer = Buffer.concat([buffer, chunk.subarray(0, bytesRead)]);
      if (path.endsWith(".zstd")) {
        const { frames } = scanZstdFrames(buffer, 1);
        if (frames.length) {
          const frame = frames[0];
          const decoded = await decompressZstdFrame(buffer.subarray(frame.start, frame.end), { maxOutputLength: MAX_HEADER_BYTES });
          return parseHeader(decoded.toString("utf8"));
        }
      } else if (buffer.includes(10)) {
        return parseHeader(buffer.toString("utf8"));
      }
    }
    throw new Error("会话头行不完整或超过大小限制");
  } finally {
    await handle.close();
  }
}

/** Mutators must never publish a successfully decoded prefix as a full log. */
export async function readSessionFile(path) {
  await assertRegularFile(path);
  const bytes = await fs.readFile(path);
  let content;
  if (path.endsWith(".zstd")) {
    const decoded = await decompressAllZstdFrames(bytes);
    if (decoded.torn) throw new Error("会话日志存在截断的 Zstd 帧，拒绝重写；请先备份并修复");
    content = decoded.content.toString("utf8");

    content = bytes.toString("utf8");

  return { meta: parseHeader(content), content, path, filename: basename(path) };
}

export async function writeTempFile(finalPath, data, io = fs) {

export async function replaceSessionFile(path, bytes, io = fs) {

    await io.rename(temp, path);

    throw new Error(`发布失败，原始会话已恢复: ${error.message}`, { cause: error });
  }
  try { await io.rm(backup, { force: true }); }
  catch { return { backupPath: backup }; }
  return {};
